name: John Sampleton
bio: Service plumbing, water heaters, and the jobs nobody else wants to crawl under a house for.

name: Pat Exampleworth
bio: Panels, rewires, and troubleshooting old knob-and-tube. I will tell you straight if it is safe.

name: Sam Placeholder
bio: Framing, decks, porches, and repairs to houses older than my grandfather.

name: Dan Mockwell
bio: Furnaces and air conditioning. If you have no heat in January, call before you call anyone else.

name: Ray Fixture
bio: Shingle and flat roofs, storm tarping, gutters. I show up when it is raining.

name: Ed Stubbs-Lorem
bio: Doors, windows, drywall, small jobs. Thirty years of fixing what the last guy left.

name: Bill Ipsum
bio: Tuckpointing, brick repair, chimneys. This city is built of brick and most of it needs me eventually.

name: Tom Testerman
bio: Interior and exterior painting. Clean lines, clean job site, no surprises on the invoice.

name: Mike Dummyfield
bio: Drain cleaning, sewer lines, and bathroom remodels. Learned the trade from a Guild brother.

name: Joe Specimen
bio: Residential service work and generator hookups. Licensed, insured, and I answer the phone.

name: Frank Mockingham
bio: Finish carpentry, cabinets, and custom woodwork. Slow, careful, and worth the wait.

name: Steve Placekeeper
bio: Heating, cooling, and ductwork. I will not sell you a new system you do not need.

name: Pete Boilerplate
bio: Handyman work of all kinds. Newest member of the Guild, and grateful for it.

name: Al Stand-In
bio: Roof replacement and repair, siding, and soffit. Storm damage is most of what I do.
